worldcombat.skill.aerialace.summary: The user blinks past the target in a burst of speed and slashes; because it charges straight at the target, the cut never misses. The pass itself is the blade line, cutting everyone it crosses, and the user ends up behind the target.
The pass crosses %1$s cuts of about %2$s damage each; every enemy the lane crosses takes them. Defence, type matchup and crit are settled on the hit.
One step reaches %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick, with a %3$s block lane width.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recover %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.growth.0: At level %1$s: cut power %2$s and %3$s cuts.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.growth.1: At level %1$s: cut power %2$s and reach %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.use.0: A crossing cut delivered in one pass
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.use.2: Pass the target and end up behind it
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.preference.s: On: skimming low widens the lane and extends the reach so one pass sweeps a row, but each cut is about 18%% weaker and windup/cooldown are longer. Off: a high, tight and heavier single cut, faster.
worldcombat.skill.aerialace.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in instead of dashing. Larger values let it cut in from further.
On: a moving enemy is preferred, because the lane cuts across its path; off: order it like a plain melee slash.
On: the user may leave its post to dash at a target; off: it only strikes from where it stands.
